faq.q: What is the origin of Tuhin?
faq.a: Tuhin is associated with Bengali. Tuhin is Bengali তুহিন (tuhin), meaning 'snow, dew'.
No — the underlying form is Bengali, not Arabic.
Tuhin can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Bengali-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Tuhin should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Tuhin is a Bengali word, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
